levels.surface: عبد الرحمن بن عبد الله بن دينار

groups.saying_opens: وأبيض يستسقى الغمام بوجهه ثمال اليتامى
ربما ذكرت قول الشاعر وأنا أنظر

notes: Two sayings with their own isnads (rule 4a): the poem with Ibn Umar as hearer, and Ibn Umar's remembered act of watching the Prophet with Umar b. Hamza's route. Read as two sayings, not as a variant.
«عن أبيه» in both places is a relation link (Abdullah b. Dinar's father; Salim's father, Ibn Umar), named only by relation.
